note: time = seconds from the take start (g 1519); frame = film g

cues.label: the jammed bridge: hooves shuffling and stamping on planks, harness jingle, nervous horse snorts, river lapping the piers far below; a worried murmur of knights
wood creaks: the packed column tries to turn on the narrow deck, rails groan, hooves scrape and clop (peaks as the riders hop round)
a horse nose bumps a horse rump: dull thump, a startled whinny
comic POP: the knight's great helm flies off his head (metal ping, short spring boing), spins, then clangs and bounces once on the planks
camera crane up and back: a rising airy whoosh as the view lifts off the deck to look down the whole bridge
everybody gives up: a collective sigh, the horses settle, hooves go quiet; only the river and a distant banner flutter
SNAP pull-out on "เหมือนกัน" (g 1608): fast whoosh with a soft thud, then the wide valley wind
